title: Design & implement curated warehouse tables for Console usage and analytics
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a set of curated, documented analytics tables in our Snowflake/BigQuery warehouse that power Console dashboards, billing reports, SLA/rate analysis, and model usage insights. Goal: produce stable, cost-conscious surfaced tables (daily and event-level) that are easy for product, SRE, and finance to consume without joining raw event blobs. Cover token usage by customer/route/model, streaming vs batch ingestion mapping, latency distributions, rollout exposure, and feature flags. Ensure PII is not present and access is governed.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical daily usage table (console_daily_usage) with one row per customer-day-route-model including token_count, request_count, avg_latency_ms, p50/p95/p99_latencies
Event-level curated table (console_events_v1) that can be joined back to daily if needed; schema includes derived route_id, model_variant, billing_unit, and anonymized_user_hash
Latency histogram/materialized view (console_latency_buckets) updated daily with consistent bucket boundaries
All tables documented in the analytics Confluence and dbt models checked into analytics repo
No PII fields stored in curated tables; any user identifiers are hashed with a rotating salt and managed via KMS integration
Query cost benchmark: common dashboard queries must execute under target cost (e.g., < $0.20/query simulated) or have a recommended materialization strategy
Access controls: grant read access to analytics group; write access restricted to CI/CD service account only
tasks: Define final schema for console_daily_usage and console_events_v1 and share with PM/SRE
Map source producers: list Kafka topics, console backend event types, and ingestion timestamps
Author dbt models and tests; add lineage metadata and descriptions
Implement partitioning and clustering guidance (date partition + customer_id clustering)
Add PII redaction and hashing step in the streaming ETL; document key rotation process
Create SQL views for common product/fiscal queries (token cost by customer, top models by latency)
Add dashboards (Grafana/Looker) wiring to new tables and validate results against existing reports
Performance test: run synthetic workload and measure query cost and latency; iterate on model/schema
Open PR for schema and dbt models; address code review feedback
Coordinate cutover plan and backfill strategy; define rollback criteria
